research_notes: Seek court and Taylor and Scott appointment/hours/leave evidence, Denman practice workload and cessation records, and identity/dates of brief corporate-law role; resolve March–June 1998 transition and overlaps with council, party and community governance.

2026-09-29 initial avenues: NSW detailed biography, inaugural speech indexed passages, BenchTV professional profile, NSW Bar Association interview, contemporary retrospective press and explicit full-time searches. APH direct opening failed; frozen roster contains no occupations. State record supplies missing month dates.

NSW Bar article calls Shoebridge's Legislative Council appointment 2008; official state service record establishes 7 September 2010. Preserve correct official date and do not propagate the article's apparent typo. Its first-person cessation account is separately useful.

Corporate-law interview is a lead with unnamed employer; do not infer exact dates from the March–June 1998 gap. Retained practising certificate and self-represented litigation are not evidence of continuing commercial employment. Month precision and unknown hours prevent headline calculation under the approved methodology.
